supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: recommendationservice_diskio z=14283769741560.13; recommendationservice_latency-90 z=3157.87 (15789.4%); recommendationservice_latency-50 z=152.46 (762.3%); recommendationservice_mem z=91.41 (457.1%)

alternatives_rejected.why: Memory rose 457% (z=91), but disk I/O deviated by z≈1.4e13, many orders of magnitude more. The memory rise is more likely a side effect of I/O-bound requests piling up (E1).

The all-services ranking in E1 shows no significant deviation for productcatalogservice; every top deviation is in recommendationservice. In E2, recommendationservice's own span self-time also rose (2.76x), so the slowdown is local to it.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the heavy disk I/O on the recommendationservice pod (for example, a runaway disk writer or stress process), then restart or reschedule the pod if latency does not recover. Confirm that p90 latency returns to its baseline.
